title: FAR chain table
description: CAIP-2 -> chain identity, independent of CoinGecko's platform list. Today Cosmos SDK chains only (EVM chains are named by their eip155 id and need no table).

chainId.description: The chain's own identifier (the Tendermint chain_id for cosmos). The CAIP-2 reference is derived from it, not always equal to it.

aliases.description: Other spellings that resolve to this row. For a hashed key, the raw `cosmos:<chain_id>` that wallets and explorers write. Never a conformant direct reference of another chain; CI enforces uniqueness across keys and aliases.

registryName.description: cosmos/chain-registry directory name. Stable across regenesis, unlike chainId.

slip44.description: HD derivation coin type the chain's wallets use (chain-registry slip44). NOT necessarily the SLIP-0044 registration of the native asset.

coingeckoPlatform.description: platforms.json slug whose caip2 is this chain, if CoinGecko has a platform for it.
